description: deepinfer.moe.olmoe_fused against llama.cpp b12024 on one RTX 4080 SUPER, OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct Q4_K_M, greedy decode, L=16, top_k=8.  Three interleaved rounds for the first version (v1) and the kept one (v3), the A/B sessions between the five versions, per-version CUPTI kernel categories, fused top-5 logits, and the RTX 3050 L=8 run.  See docs/OLMOE_PORT_PLAN.md section 38; variants are patches in olmoe_sm89_fused_variants/.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER 32 GB (SM89), driver 580.105.08
environment.cpu: Intel Xeon Platinum 8352V @ 2.10GHz, cgroup quota 16 CPUs
environment.llama_cpp: b12024 (ddf48f8), built from source, CUDA 12.4, sm_89

versions.v1: ten kernels per layer, 164 per token
versions.v2: v1 + fused route/attend + row loaded before staging x + gate/up on warp pairs
versions.v3: v1's GEMVs + fused route (norm, router, top-k) + fused attend with 512 threads; kept
versions.v4: v3 with x read through L1 and weights L2-only, no shared staging
versions.v5: v3 + o_proj weights prefetched into L2 on a side graph branch during attention

ab_sessions.note: v2 decodes 'The population of France is 67 million.' where v1 and the graph path say 'is around 67 million people.' - a near-tie flipped by the reordered norm sums
